import Mathlib

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxRecDepth 4096
set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
set_option linter.unusedSimpArgs false

namespace FalconerCore

open Finset

def Representatives (A : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (r : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ b, b * q ≤ r b ∧ r b < (b + 1) * q ∧
    ∀ n, b * q ≤ n → n < (b + 1) * q → A (r b) ≤ A n

theorem representatives_exist (A : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ r, Representatives A q r := by
  have hex : ∀ b : ℕ, ∃ p, b * q ≤ p ∧ p < (b + 1) * q ∧
      ∀ n, b * q ≤ n → n < (b + 1) * q → A p ≤ A n := by
    intro b
    have hn : (Ico (b * q) ((b + 1) * q)).Nonempty := by
      exact ⟨b * q, by simp only [mem_Ico, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]; omega⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hm⟩ := exists_min_image (Ico (b * q) ((b + 1) * q)) A hn
    exact ⟨p, (mem_Ico.mp hp).1, (mem_Ico.mp hp).2,
      fun n hn₁ hn₂ => hm n (mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hn₁, hn₂⟩)⟩
  choose r hr using hex
  exact ⟨r, hr⟩

def Eligible (q a t b : ℕ) : Prop :=
  a + q ≤ b * q ∧ (b + 1) * q + q ≤ t + 1

structure Policy (A : ℕ → ℝ) (q a t p : ℕ) : Prop where
  left : a + q ≤ p
  right : p + q ≤ t
  left_min : ∀ n, a + 2 * q ≤ n → n ≤ p → A p ≤ A n
  right_min : ∀ n, p ≤ n → n + 2 * q ≤ t → A p ≤ A n

theorem selected_policy {A : ℕ → ℝ} {q a t b : ℕ} {r : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hr : Representatives A q r)
    (hb : Eligible q a t b)
    (hmin : ∀ c, Eligible q a t c → A (r b) ≤ A (r c)) :
    Policy A q a t (r b) := by
  obtain ⟨hb₁, hb₂, hbmin⟩ := hr b
  obtain ⟨he₁, he₂⟩ := hb
  constructor
  · omega
  · omega
  · intro n hn hnp
    let c := n / q
    have hc₁ : c * q ≤ n := Nat.div_mul_le_self n q
    have hc₂ : n < c * q + q := by
      simpa only [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one, Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.lt_mul_div_succ n hq
    have hcb : c ≤ b := by
      by_contra h
      have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right q (show b + 1 ≤ c by omega)
      omega
    have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right q (Nat.add_le_add_right hcb 1)
    have hec : Eligible q a t c := by
      constructor <;> simp only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] at * <;> omega
    exact (hmin c hec).trans ((hr c).2.2 n hc₁ (by
      simpa only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] using hc₂))
  · intro n hpn hn
    let c := n / q
    have hc₁ : c * q ≤ n := Nat.div_mul_le_self n q
    have hc₂ : n < c * q + q := by
      simpa only [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one, Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.lt_mul_div_succ n hq
    have hbc : b ≤ c := by
      by_contra h
      have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right q (show c + 1 ≤ b by omega)
      simp only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] at hmul
      omega
    have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right q hbc
    have hec : Eligible q a t c := by
      constructor <;> simp only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] at * <;> omega
    exact (hmin c hec).trans ((hr c).2.2 n hc₁ (by
      simpa only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] using hc₂))

theorem eligible_exists {q a t : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hw : a + 100 * q < t) :
    ∃ b ≤ t, Eligible q a t b := by
  let b := (a + q) / q + 1
  have h₁ := Nat.div_mul_le_self (a + q) q
  have h₂ : a + q < (a + q) / q * q + q := by
    simpa only [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one, Nat.mul_comm] using
      Nat.lt_mul_div_succ (a + q) hq
  have hb : Eligible q a t b := by
    dsimp [Eligible, b]
    simp only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one] at *
    constructor <;> omega
  have hbt : b ≤ t := by
    have hmul : b ≤ b * q := by
      simpa only [Nat.mul_one] using Nat.mul_le_mul_left b (show 1 ≤ q by omega)
    obtain ⟨_, hb₂⟩ := hb
    simp only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] at hb₂
    omega
  exact ⟨b, hbt, hb⟩

def Anchors (N q : ℕ) (r : ℕ → ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (range (N / q + 1)).image r

def ValidPolicy (A : ℕ → ℝ) (q N : ℕ) (R : Finset ℕ)
    (choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ a t, a + 100 * q < t → t ≤ N →
    Policy A q a t (choice a t) ∧ choice a t ∈ R

theorem actual_policy_exists {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q : ℕ} {r : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hr : Representatives A q r) :
    ∃ choice, ValidPolicy A q N (Anchors N q r) choice := by
  classical
  have hex : ∀ a t, ∃ p, (a + 100 * q < t ∧ t ≤ N) →
      Policy A q a t p ∧ p ∈ Anchors N q r := by
    intro a t
    by_cases hw : a + 100 * q < t ∧ t ≤ N
    · let E := (range (t + 1)).filter (Eligible q a t)
      obtain ⟨b, hbt, hb⟩ := eligible_exists hq hw.1
      have hn : E.Nonempty := ⟨b, by simp [E, hbt, hb]⟩
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hm⟩ := exists_min_image E (fun b => A (r b)) hn
      have hec : Eligible q a t c := (mem_filter.mp hc).2
      have hsel : ∀ d, Eligible q a t d → A (r c) ≤ A (r d) := by
        intro d hd
        have hdt : d ≤ t := by
          have hmul : d ≤ d * q := by
            simpa only [Nat.mul_one] using Nat.mul_le_mul_left d (show 1 ≤ q by omega)
          obtain ⟨_, hd₂⟩ := hd
          simp only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] at hd₂
          omega
        exact hm d (by simp [E, hdt, hd])
      have hp := selected_policy hq hr hec hsel
      have hcN : c ≤ N / q := by
        apply (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hq).mpr
        have hc₁ := (hr c).1
        have hc₂ := hp.right
        omega
      exact ⟨r c, fun _ => ⟨hp, mem_image.mpr ⟨c, by simp [hcN], rfl⟩⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨0, fun h => False.elim (hw h)⟩
  choose choice hchoice using hex
  exact ⟨choice, fun a t hw ht => hchoice a t ⟨hw, ht⟩⟩

theorem anchors_card (N q : ℕ) (r : ℕ → ℕ) :
    (Anchors N q r).card ≤ N / q + 1 := by
  exact (card_image_le).trans (by simp)

abbrev Descriptor := Bool × ℕ × ℕ

def anchor (d : Descriptor) : ℕ := d.2.1
def nominal (d : Descriptor) : ℕ := d.2.2

def Generates (a t p : ℕ) (d : Descriptor) : Prop :=
  (d.1 = false ∧ anchor d = p ∧ 0 < nominal d ∧
    nominal d ≤ p - a ∧ nominal d ≤ t - p) ∨
  (d.1 = true ∧ anchor d = p ∧ 2 * p > a + t ∧
    nominal d = t - p)

def Scheduled (q : ℕ) (choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (a t : ℕ)
    (d : Descriptor) : Prop :=
  ∃ b u, a ≤ b ∧ u ≤ t ∧ b + 100 * q < u ∧ Generates b u (choice b u) d

def Universe (N : ℕ) : Finset Descriptor :=
  (univ : Finset Bool) ×ˢ (range (N + 1) ×ˢ range (N + 1))

noncomputable def schedule (N q : ℕ) (choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (a t : ℕ) :
    Finset Descriptor := by
  classical
  exact (Universe N).filter (Scheduled q choice a t)

theorem scheduled_nested {q a t b u : ℕ} {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hut : u ≤ t) {d : Descriptor}
    (hd : Scheduled q choice b u d) : Scheduled q choice a t d := by
  obtain ⟨c, v, hbc, hvu, hw, hg⟩ := hd
  exact ⟨c, v, hab.trans hbc, hvu.trans hut, hw, hg⟩

theorem schedule_nested {N q a t b u : ℕ} {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hut : u ≤ t) :
    schedule N q choice b u ⊆ schedule N q choice a t := by
  classical
  intro d hd
  obtain ⟨hU, hS⟩ := mem_filter.mp hd
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨hU, scheduled_nested hab hut hS⟩

theorem schedule_card (N q a t : ℕ) (choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) :
    (schedule N q choice a t).card ≤ 2 * (N + 1) * (N + 1) := by
  classical
  calc
    _ ≤ (Universe N).card := card_filter_le _ _
    _ = _ := by simp [Universe, Nat.mul_assoc]

theorem scheduled_origin {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q a t : ℕ} {R : Finset ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {d : Descriptor}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hp : ValidPolicy A q N R choice) (ht : t ≤ N)
    (hd : Scheduled q choice a t d) :
    ∃ b u, a ≤ b ∧ u ≤ t ∧ Policy A q b u (anchor d) ∧
      anchor d ∈ R ∧ 0 < nominal d ∧ b + nominal d ≤ anchor d ∧
      anchor d + nominal d ≤ u ∧
      ∀ l, 0 < l → l ≤ nominal d →
        Scheduled q choice a t (false, anchor d, l) := by
  obtain ⟨b, u, hab, hut, hw, hg⟩ := hd
  obtain ⟨hpol, hrep⟩ := hp b u hw (hut.trans ht)
  have hbp := hpol.left
  have hpu := hpol.right
  have hg' : anchor d = choice b u ∧ 0 < nominal d ∧
      nominal d ≤ choice b u - b ∧ nominal d ≤ u - choice b u := by
    rcases hg with h | h
    · exact ⟨h.2.1, h.2.2⟩
    · obtain ⟨_, ha, hsuf, hl⟩ := h
      refine ⟨ha, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> omega
  obtain ⟨ha, hl, hlb, hlu⟩ := hg'
  refine ⟨b, u, hab, hut, ?_, ?_, hl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [ha] using hpol
  · simpa only [ha] using hrep
  · omega
  · omega
  · intro l hlpos hll
    refine ⟨b, u, hab, hut, hw, Or.inl ?_⟩
    exact ⟨rfl, ha, hlpos, hll.trans hlb, hll.trans hlu⟩

def Admissible (q a t i j : ℕ) : Prop :=
  a ≤ i ∧ i + 10 * q ≤ j ∧ j ≤ t

def Potential (A : ℕ → ℝ) (q a t : ℕ) (V : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∃ i j, Admissible q a t i j ∧ V = A i + A j) ∧
    ∀ i j, Admissible q a t i j → V ≤ A i + A j

theorem potential_exists (A : ℕ → ℝ) (q a t : ℕ) (hw : a + 10 * q ≤ t) :
    ∃ V, Potential A q a t V := by
  classical
  let E := ((range (t + 1)) ×ˢ (range (t + 1))).filter
    (fun ij => Admissible q a t ij.1 ij.2)
  have hn : E.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨(a, a + 10 * q), ?_⟩
    simp [E, Admissible]
    omega
  obtain ⟨ij, hij, hm⟩ := exists_min_image E (fun ij => A ij.1 + A ij.2) hn
  refine ⟨A ij.1 + A ij.2, ⟨ij.1, ij.2, (mem_filter.mp hij).2, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  intro i j h
  apply hm (i, j)
  simp [E, Admissible] at *
  omega

def Minimum (A : ℕ → ℝ) (a t r : ℕ) : Prop :=
  a ≤ r ∧ r ≤ t ∧ ∀ n, a ≤ n → n ≤ t → A r ≤ A n

theorem minimum_exists (A : ℕ → ℝ) (a t : ℕ) (hat : a ≤ t) :
    ∃ r, Minimum A a t r := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hm⟩ := exists_min_image (Icc a t) A ⟨a, by simp [hat]⟩
  exact ⟨r, (mem_Icc.mp hr).1, (mem_Icc.mp hr).2,
    fun n hn₁ hn₂ => hm n (mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hn₁, hn₂⟩)⟩

theorem payment_by_replacement {A : ℕ → ℝ} {q a t b u : ℕ} {V W c : ℝ}
    (hV : Potential A q a t V) (hW : Potential A q b u W)
    (hreplace : ∀ i j, Admissible q b u i j →
      ∃ x y, Admissible q a t x y ∧ A x + A y ≤ A i + A j - c) :
    c ≤ W - V := by
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hsum⟩ := hW.1
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, hpay⟩ := hreplace i j hij
  have := hV.2 x y hxy
  linarith

theorem potential_monotone {A : ℕ → ℝ} {q a t b u : ℕ} {V W : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hut : u ≤ t)
    (hV : Potential A q a t V) (hW : Potential A q b u W) :
    0 ≤ W - V := by
  apply payment_by_replacement hV hW
  intro i j h
  exact ⟨i, j, ⟨hab.trans h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.trans hut⟩, by linarith⟩

theorem suffix_width {A : ℕ → ℝ} {q a t p : ℕ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hw : a + 100 * q < t)
    (hp : Policy A q a t p) (hs : a + t < 2 * p) :
    a + 10 * q ≤ p := by
  have := hp.right
  omega

theorem suffix_payment {A : ℕ → ℝ} {q a t p r : ℕ} {V W : ℝ}
    (hp : Policy A q a t p) (hr : Minimum A p t r)
    (hV : Potential A q a t V) (hW : Potential A q a p W) :
    A p - A r ≤ W - V := by
  obtain ⟨hpr, hrt, hrmin⟩ := hr
  apply payment_by_replacement hV hW
  intro i j hij
  have hmin : A p ≤ A j := hp.left_min j (by
    dsimp [Admissible] at hij
    omega) hij.2.2
  refine ⟨i, r, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp [Admissible] at *
    omega
  · linarith

theorem high_width {A : ℕ → ℝ} {q s a t p v : ℕ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hs : s ≤ q) (hw : a + 100 * q < t)
    (hp : Policy A q a t p) (hpre : 2 * p ≤ a + t)
    (hv : t ≤ v + s) : p + 10 * q ≤ v := by
  have := hp.left
  omega

theorem high_payment {A : ℕ → ℝ} {q a t p v r : ℕ} {V W : ℝ}
    (hp : Policy A q a t p) (hv : v ≤ t) (hr : Minimum A a p r)
    (hV : Potential A q a t V) (hW : Potential A q p v W) :
    A p - A r ≤ W - V := by
  obtain ⟨har, hrp, hrmin⟩ := hr
  apply payment_by_replacement hV hW
  intro i j hij
  have hmin : A p ≤ A i := hp.right_min i hij.1 (by
    dsimp [Admissible] at hij
    omega)
  refine ⟨r, j, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp [Admissible] at *
    omega
  · linarith

theorem direct_width {q s a v p L : ℕ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hs : s ≤ q) (hw : a + 100 * q < v)
    (hlen : p + L ≤ v + s) (hdir : v ≤ a + 2 * L) :
    p + 10 * q ≤ v := by
  omega

theorem inherited_origin_payment {A : ℕ → ℝ} {q a v p b u L r : ℕ}
    {V W : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hap : a ≤ p)
    (hp : Policy A q b u p) (hleft : b + L ≤ p) (hright : p + L ≤ u)
    (hdir : v ≤ a + 2 * L) (hr : Minimum A a p r)
    (hV : Potential A q a v V) (hW : Potential A q p v W) :
    A p - A r ≤ W - V := by
  obtain ⟨har, hrp, hrmin⟩ := hr
  have hnonneg : A r ≤ A p := hrmin p hap (le_refl p)
  by_cases heq : A r = A p
  · have hm := potential_monotone hap (le_refl v) hV hW
    linarith
  have hstrict : A r < A p := lt_of_le_of_ne hnonneg heq
  have hescape : r < b + 2 * q := by
    by_contra h
    have := hp.left_min r (by omega) hrp
    linarith
  have hend : v < u + 2 * q := by omega
  apply payment_by_replacement hV hW
  intro i j hij
  have hmin : A p ≤ A i := hp.right_min i hij.1 (by
    dsimp [Admissible] at hij
    omega)
  refine ⟨r, j, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp [Admissible] at *
    omega
  · linarith

noncomputable def remaining (N q : ℕ) (choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (b u a : ℕ) : Finset Descriptor := by
  classical
  exact (schedule N q choice b u).filter (fun d => a < anchor d)

noncomputable def longest (N q : ℕ) (choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (b u a : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (remaining N q choice b u a).sup nominal

theorem remaining_anchor {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q b u a : ℕ} {R : Finset ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {d : Descriptor} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hp : ValidPolicy A q N R choice) (hu : u ≤ N)
    (hd : d ∈ remaining N q choice b u a) :
    anchor d ∈ R ∧ a < anchor d := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hs, ha⟩ := mem_filter.mp hd
  have ho := scheduled_origin hq hp hu (mem_filter.mp hs).2
  obtain ⟨b', u', _, _, _, hr, _⟩ := ho
  exact ⟨hr, ha⟩

def remainingAnchors (R : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  R.filter (fun p => a < p)

theorem remainingAnchors_mono {R : Finset ℕ} {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    remainingAnchors R b ⊆ remainingAnchors R a := by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨hR, hbp⟩ := mem_filter.mp hp
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨hR, by omega⟩

theorem remainingAnchors_drop {R : Finset ℕ} {a b p : ℕ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hp : p ∈ R) (hap : a < p) (hpb : p ≤ b) :
    (remainingAnchors R b).card < (remainingAnchors R a).card := by
  apply card_lt_card
  apply Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr
  refine ⟨remainingAnchors_mono hab, ?_⟩
  intro heq
  have hm : p ∈ remainingAnchors R a := mem_filter.mpr ⟨hp, hap⟩
  rw [← heq] at hm
  have := (mem_filter.mp hm).2
  omega

theorem remaining_stable {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q b u a a' : ℕ}
    {R : Finset ℕ} {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hp : ValidPolicy A q N R choice) (hu : u ≤ N) (haa' : a ≤ a')
    (hno : ¬ ∃ p ∈ R, a < p ∧ p ≤ a') :
    remaining N q choice b u a' = remaining N q choice b u a := by
  classical
  ext d
  constructor
  · intro hd
    obtain ⟨hs, ha⟩ := mem_filter.mp hd
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨hs, by omega⟩
  · intro hd
    obtain ⟨hs, ha⟩ := mem_filter.mp hd
    have hR := (remaining_anchor hq hp hu hd).1
    have hap : a' < anchor d := by
      by_contra h
      exact hno ⟨anchor d, hR, ha, by omega⟩
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨hs, hap⟩

inductive Kind where
  | positive
  | angular (baseLeft baseRight : ℕ)
  deriving DecidableEq

structure State where
  start : ℕ
  finish : ℕ
  index : ℕ
  kind : Kind
  deriving DecidableEq

def Valid (N s : ℕ) (x : State) : Prop :=
  x.start ≤ x.finish ∧ x.finish ≤ N ∧
    match x.kind with
    | .positive => True
    | .angular b u => b ≤ x.start ∧ x.finish ≤ u ∧ u ≤ x.finish + s ∧ u ≤ N

def P (a t i : ℕ) : State := ⟨a, t, i, .positive⟩
def H (b u a v i : ℕ) : State := ⟨a, v, i, .angular b u⟩

noncomputable def splitLength (N q f : ℕ) (choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (b u a : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  max (longest N q choice b u a) f

inductive Row (A : ℕ → ℝ) (N q s f : ℕ) (choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) :
    State → State → ℝ → Bool → Prop where
  | suffix (a t i r : ℕ) (hs : a + t < 2 * choice a t)
      (hm : Minimum A (choice a t) t r) :
      Row A N q s f choice (P a t i) (P a (choice a t) (i + 1))
        (A (choice a t) - A r) false
  | low (a t v i : ℕ) (hv : a < v) (hs : v + s ≤ t) :
      Row A N q s f choice (P a t i) (P a v (i + 1)) 0 true
  | high (a t v i r : ℕ) (hpre : 2 * choice a t ≤ a + t)
      (hv : v ≤ t) (hs : t < v + s) (hm : Minimum A a (choice a t) r) :
      Row A N q s f choice (P a t i) (H a t (choice a t) v i)
        (A (choice a t) - A r) false
  | direct (b u a v i r : ℕ) (d : Descriptor)
      (hd : d ∈ remaining N q choice b u a)
      (hmax : nominal d = longest N q choice b u a)
      (hsplit : v ≤ a + 2 * splitLength N q f choice b u a)
      (hm : Minimum A a (anchor d) r) :
      Row A N q s f choice (H b u a v i) (H b u (anchor d) v i)
        (A (anchor d) - A r) false
  | near (b u a v i : ℕ)
      (hsplit : a + 2 * splitLength N q f choice b u a < v) :
      Row A N q s f choice (H b u a v i)
        (H b u (v - 2 * splitLength N q f choice b u a) v i) 0 false
  | far (b u a v i a' : ℕ)
      (hsplit : a + 2 * splitLength N q f choice b u a < v)
      (ha : a < a') (hv : a' < v) :
      Row A N q s f choice (H b u a v i) (P a' v (i + 1)) 0 false

structure Step (A : ℕ → ℝ) (N q s f : ℕ) (choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (x y : State) (cost : ℝ) (low : Bool) : Prop where
  valid : Valid N s x
  nonterminal : x.start + 100 * q < x.finish
  row : Row A N q s f choice x y cost low

theorem direct_geometry {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q s f b u a v : ℕ}
    {R : Finset ℕ} {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {d : Descriptor}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hs : s ≤ q) (hf : f ≤ 10 * q)
    (hp : ValidPolicy A q N R choice) (hvalid : Valid N s (H b u a v 0))
    (hw : a + 100 * q < v)
    (hd : d ∈ remaining N q choice b u a)
    (hmax : nominal d = longest N q choice b u a)
    (hsplit : v ≤ a + 2 * splitLength N q f choice b u a) :
    a < anchor d ∧ anchor d + 10 * q ≤ v ∧
      v ≤ a + 2 * nominal d ∧
      ∃ b' u', Policy A q b' u' (anchor d) ∧
        b' + nominal d ≤ anchor d ∧ anchor d + nominal d ≤ u' := by
  classical
  simp only [H, Valid, State.start, State.finish, State.kind] at hvalid
  obtain ⟨hav, hvN, hba, hvu, huv, huN⟩ := hvalid
  have hfloor : splitLength N q f choice b u a = nominal d := by
    dsimp [splitLength]
    rw [← hmax]
    by_cases h : f ≤ nominal d
    · exact max_eq_left h
    · have hL : nominal d ≤ f := by omega
      simp only [splitLength, ← hmax, max_eq_right hL] at hsplit
      omega
  rw [hfloor] at hsplit
  have ha := (remaining_anchor hq hp huN hd).2
  obtain ⟨hlist, _⟩ := mem_filter.mp hd
  obtain ⟨b', u', _, hu't, hpol, _, _, hleft, hright, _⟩ :=
    scheduled_origin hq hp huN (mem_filter.mp hlist).2
  have hlen : anchor d + nominal d ≤ v + s := by omega
  have hwidth := direct_width hq hs hw hlen hsplit
  exact ⟨ha, hwidth, hsplit, b', u', hpol, hleft, hright⟩

theorem step_nested {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q s f : ℕ} {R : Finset ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {x y : State} {c : ℝ} {low : Bool}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs : s ≤ q) (hf : f ≤ 10 * q)
    (hp : ValidPolicy A q N R choice)
    (h : Step A N q s f choice x y c low) :
    x.start ≤ y.start ∧ y.finish ≤ x.finish ∧ y.start ≤ y.finish ∧
      y.finish - y.start < x.finish - x.start ∧ Valid N s y := by
  obtain ⟨hv, hw, hr⟩ := h
  cases hr with
  | suffix a t i r hsuf hm =>
    simp only [P, Valid, and_true] at hv hw ⊢
    obtain ⟨hpol, _⟩ := hp a t hw hv.2
    have hl := hpol.left
    have ht := hpol.right
    omega
  | low a t v i ha ht =>
    simp only [P, Valid, and_true] at hv hw ⊢
    omega
  | high a t v i r hpre hvt hvs hm =>
    simp only [P, H, Valid, and_true] at hv hw ⊢
    obtain ⟨hpol, _⟩ := hp a t hw hv.2
    have hl := hpol.left
    have hwidth := high_width (v := v) hq hs hw hpol hpre (by omega)
    omega
  | direct b u a v i r d hd hmax hsplit hm =>
    simp only [H, Valid, State.start, State.finish, State.kind] at hv hw ⊢
    have hv0 : Valid N s (H b u a v 0) := hv
    obtain ⟨ha, ht, _⟩ := direct_geometry hq hs hf hp hv0 hw hd hmax hsplit
    omega
  | near b u a v i hsplit =>
    simp only [H, Valid, State.start, State.finish, State.kind] at hv hw ⊢
    omega
  | far b u a v i a' hsplit ha ht =>
    simp only [P, H, Valid, and_true] at hv hw ⊢
    omega

theorem step_payment {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q s f : ℕ} {R : Finset ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {x y : State} {c V W : ℝ} {low : Bool}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs : s ≤ q) (hf : f ≤ 10 * q)
    (hp : ValidPolicy A q N R choice)
    (h : Step A N q s f choice x y c low)
    (hV : Potential A q x.start x.finish V)
    (hW : Potential A q y.start y.finish W) : c ≤ W - V := by
  have hn := step_nested hq hs0 hs hf hp h
  obtain ⟨hv, hw, hr⟩ := h
  cases hr with
  | suffix a t i r hsuf hm =>
    simp only [P, State.start, State.finish, State.kind] at hw
    exact suffix_payment (hp a t hw hv.2.1).1 hm hV hW
  | low a t v i ha ht => exact potential_monotone hn.1 hn.2.1 hV hW
  | high a t v i r hpre hvt hvs hm =>
    simp only [P, State.start, State.finish, State.kind] at hw
    exact high_payment (hp a t hw hv.2.1).1 hvt hm hV hW
  | direct b u a v i r d hd hmax hsplit hm =>
    simp only [H, State.start, State.finish, State.kind] at hw
    have hv0 : Valid N s (H b u a v 0) := hv
    obtain ⟨ha, _, hdir, b', u', hpol, hleft, hright⟩ :=
      direct_geometry hq hs hf hp hv0 hw hd hmax hsplit
    exact inherited_origin_payment hq (by omega) hpol hleft hright hdir hm hV hW
  | near b u a v i hsplit => exact potential_monotone hn.1 hn.2.1 hV hW
  | far b u a v i a' hsplit ha ht => exact potential_monotone hn.1 hn.2.1 hV hW

theorem short_child_zero_cost {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q s f : ℕ} {R : Finset ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {x y : State} {c : ℝ} {low : Bool}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hs : s ≤ q) (hf : f ≤ 10 * q)
    (hp : ValidPolicy A q N R choice)
    (h : Step A N q s f choice x y c low)
    (hshort : y.finish < y.start + 10 * q) : c = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨hv, hw, hr⟩ := h
  cases hr with
  | suffix a t i r hsuf hm =>
    simp only [P, State.start, State.finish, State.kind] at hw
    have := suffix_width hq hw (hp a t hw hv.2.1).1 hsuf
    simp only [P, State.start, State.finish] at hshort
    omega
  | low => rfl
  | high a t v i r hpre hvt hvs hm =>
    simp only [P, State.start, State.finish, State.kind] at hw
    have := high_width (v := v) hq hs hw (hp a t hw hv.2.1).1 hpre (by omega)
    simp only [H, State.start, State.finish] at hshort
    omega
  | direct b u a v i r d hd hmax hsplit hm =>
    simp only [H, State.start, State.finish, State.kind] at hw
    have hv0 : Valid N s (H b u a v 0) := hv
    have := (direct_geometry hq hs hf hp hv0 hw hd hmax hsplit).2.1
    simp only [H, State.start, State.finish] at hshort
    omega
  | near => rfl
  | far => rfl

noncomputable def credit (N q f : ℕ) (choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (x : State) : ℕ :=
  match x.kind with
  | .positive => 0
  | .angular b u =>
    if x.start + 100 * q < x.finish then
      if x.start + 2 * splitLength N q f choice b u x.start < x.finish then 2 else 1
    else 0

noncomputable def tokens (N q f : ℕ) (choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (R : Finset ℕ) (x : State) : ℕ :=
  3 * (remainingAnchors R x.start).card + credit N q f choice x

noncomputable def resource (N q f : ℕ) (choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (R : Finset ℕ) (x : State) : ℕ :=
  q * tokens N q f choice R x + x.finish

theorem credit_le_two (N q f : ℕ) (choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (x : State) :
    credit N q f choice x ≤ 2 := by
  unfold credit
  cases x.kind <;> simp only
  · omega
  · split_ifs <;> omega

theorem angular_credit_positive {N q f b u a v i : ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} (hw : a + 100 * q < v) :
    1 ≤ credit N q f choice (H b u a v i) := by
  simp only [credit, H, hw, ite_true]
  split_ifs <;> omega

theorem resource_of_token_drop {N q f : ℕ} {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ}
    {R : Finset ℕ} {x y : State} (ht : y.finish ≤ x.finish)
    (hd : tokens N q f choice R y + 1 ≤ tokens N q f choice R x) :
    resource N q f choice R y + q ≤ resource N q f choice R x := by
  have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_left q hd
  simp only [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one] at hm
  dsimp [resource]
  omega

theorem step_resources {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q s f : ℕ} {R : Finset ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {x y : State} {c : ℝ} {low : Bool}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs : s ≤ q) (hf : f ≤ 10 * q)
    (hp : ValidPolicy A q N R choice)
    (h : Step A N q s f choice x y c low) :
    resource N q f choice R y + (if low then s else q) ≤
      resource N q f choice R x ∧
    y.finish + (if low then s else 0) ≤ x.finish ∧ y.index ≤ x.index + 1 := by
  have hn := step_nested hq hs0 hs hf hp h
  obtain ⟨hv, hw, hr⟩ := h
  cases hr with
  | suffix a t i r hsuf hm =>
    have ht := (hp a t hw hv.2.1).1.right
    simp only [resource, tokens, credit, P, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false]
    omega
  | low a t v i ha ht =>
    simp only [resource, tokens, credit, P, Bool.true_eq, ite_true]
    omega
  | high a t v i r hpre hvt hvs hm =>
    obtain ⟨hpol, hrep⟩ := hp a t hw hv.2.1
    have hl := hpol.left
    have hdrop := remainingAnchors_drop (R := R)
      (show a ≤ choice a t by omega) hrep (by omega) (le_refl (choice a t))
    have hc := credit_le_two N q f choice (H a t (choice a t) v i)
    have ht : tokens N q f choice R (H a t (choice a t) v i) + 1 ≤
        tokens N q f choice R (P a t i) := by
      simp only [tokens, credit, P]
      change 3 * (remainingAnchors R (choice a t)).card +
        credit N q f choice (H a t (choice a t) v i) + 1 ≤
        3 * (remainingAnchors R a).card
      omega
    have hd := resource_of_token_drop hvt ht
    exact ⟨hd, by simpa [H, P] using hvt, by simp [H, P]⟩
  | direct b u a v i r d hd hmax hsplit hm =>
    have hv0 : Valid N s (H b u a v 0) := hv
    have hu : u ≤ N := hv.2.2.2.2.2
    have ha := (remaining_anchor hq hp hu hd).2
    have hrep := (remaining_anchor hq hp hu hd).1
    have hdrop := remainingAnchors_drop (R := R) (by omega) hrep ha (le_refl (anchor d))
    have hc := credit_le_two N q f choice (H b u (anchor d) v i)
    have ht : tokens N q f choice R (H b u (anchor d) v i) + 1 ≤
        tokens N q f choice R (H b u a v i) := by
      simp only [tokens, H]
      change 3 * (remainingAnchors R (anchor d)).card +
        credit N q f choice (H b u (anchor d) v i) + 1 ≤
        3 * (remainingAnchors R a).card + credit N q f choice (H b u a v i)
      omega
    exact ⟨resource_of_token_drop (le_refl v) ht, by simp [H], by simp [H]⟩
  | near b u a v i hsplit =>
    let a' := v - 2 * splitLength N q f choice b u a
    have haa' : a < a' := by dsimp [a']; omega
    have hmono := card_le_card (remainingAnchors_mono (R := R) (le_of_lt haa'))
    have hc := credit_le_two N q f choice (H b u a' v i)
    have hparent : credit N q f choice (H b u a v i) = 2 := by
      have hw' : a + 100 * q < v := hw
      simp only [credit, H, hw', hsplit, ite_true]
    have ht : tokens N q f choice R (H b u a' v i) + 1 ≤
        tokens N q f choice R (H b u a v i) := by
      by_cases hhit : ∃ p ∈ R, a < p ∧ p ≤ a'
      · obtain ⟨p, hpR, hap, hpa'⟩ := hhit
        have hdrop := remainingAnchors_drop (le_of_lt haa') hpR hap hpa'
        simp only [tokens, H]
        change 3 * (remainingAnchors R a').card +
          credit N q f choice (H b u a' v i) + 1 ≤
          3 * (remainingAnchors R a).card + credit N q f choice (H b u a v i)
        omega
      · have hu : u ≤ N := hv.2.2.2.2.2
        have heq := remaining_stable (b := b) hq hp hu (le_of_lt haa') hhit
        have hL : splitLength N q f choice b u a' =
            splitLength N q f choice b u a := by
          unfold splitLength longest
          rw [heq]
        have hback : ¬ a' + 2 * splitLength N q f choice b u a' < v := by
          rw [hL]
          dsimp [a']
          omega
        have hc' : credit N q f choice (H b u a' v i) ≤ 1 := by
          simp only [credit, H]
          split_ifs <;> omega
        simp only [tokens, H]
        change 3 * (remainingAnchors R a').card +
          credit N q f choice (H b u a' v i) + 1 ≤
          3 * (remainingAnchors R a).card + credit N q f choice (H b u a v i)
        omega
    exact ⟨resource_of_token_drop (le_refl v) ht, by simp [H], by simp [H]⟩
  | far b u a v i a' hsplit ha ht =>
    have hmono := card_le_card (remainingAnchors_mono (R := R) (le_of_lt ha))
    have hc := angular_credit_positive (N := N) (f := f) (b := b) (u := u) (a := a) (v := v)
      (choice := choice) (i := i) hw
    have htoken : tokens N q f choice R (P a' v (i + 1)) + 1 ≤
        tokens N q f choice R (H b u a v i) := by
      simp only [tokens, credit, P]
      change 3 * (remainingAnchors R a').card + 0 + 1 ≤
        3 * (remainingAnchors R a).card + credit N q f choice (H b u a v i)
      omega
    exact ⟨resource_of_token_drop (le_refl v) htoken, by simp [H, P], by simp [H, P]⟩

inductive Run (A : ℕ → ℝ) (N q s f : ℕ) (choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) :
    State → State → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → Prop where
  | nil (x : State) : Run A N q s f choice x x 0 0 0
  | cons {x y z : State} {c C : ℝ} {low : Bool} {n m : ℕ}
      (step : Step A N q s f choice x y c low)
      (tail : Run A N q s f choice y z n m C) :
      Run A N q s f choice x z
        (n + if low then 0 else 1) (m + if low then 1 else 0) (c + C)

theorem run_resources {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q s f : ℕ} {R : Finset ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {x z : State} {n m : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs : s ≤ q) (hf : f ≤ 10 * q)
    (hp : ValidPolicy A q N R choice)
    (h : Run A N q s f choice x z n m C) :
    q * n + resource N q f choice R z ≤ resource N q f choice R x ∧
      s * m + z.finish ≤ x.finish ∧ z.index ≤ x.index + n + m := by
  induction h with
  | nil x => simp
  | @cons x y z c C low n m hstep htail ih =>
    have hd := step_resources hq hs0 hs hf hp hstep
    cases low <;>
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.true_eq, ite_false, ite_true,
        Nat.add_zero, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one, Nat.mul_zero] at * <;>
      omega

theorem run_nested {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q s f : ℕ} {R : Finset ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {x z : State} {n m : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs : s ≤ q) (hf : f ≤ 10 * q)
    (hp : ValidPolicy A q N R choice) (hx : Valid N s x)
    (h : Run A N q s f choice x z n m C) :
    x.start ≤ z.start ∧ z.finish ≤ x.finish ∧ Valid N s z := by
  induction h with
  | nil x => exact ⟨le_refl _, le_refl _, hx⟩
  | cons hstep htail ih =>
    have hn := step_nested hq hs0 hs hf hp hstep
    obtain ⟨ha, ht, hv⟩ := ih hn.2.2.2.2
    exact ⟨hn.1.trans ha, ht.trans hn.2.1, hv⟩

theorem terminal_run {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q s f : ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {x z : State} {n m : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hw : x.finish ≤ x.start + 100 * q)
    (h : Run A N q s f choice x z n m C) :
    z = x ∧ n = 0 ∧ m = 0 ∧ C = 0 := by
  cases h with
  | nil => exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  | cons hstep htail =>
    have := hstep.nonterminal
    omega

theorem run_integer_budget {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q s f : ℕ} {R : Finset ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {x z : State} {n m : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs : s ≤ q) (hf : f ≤ 10 * q)
    (hp : ValidPolicy A q N R choice) (hx : Valid N s x)
    (h : Run A N q s f choice x z n m C) :
    q * n ≤ q * (3 * R.card + 2) + N ∧ s * m ≤ N ∧
      z.index ≤ x.index + n + m := by
  obtain ⟨hr, hl, hi⟩ := run_resources hq hs0 hs hf hp h
  have hcard : (remainingAnchors R x.start).card ≤ R.card := card_filter_le _ _
  have hc := credit_le_two N q f choice x
  have ht : tokens N q f choice R x ≤ 3 * R.card + 2 := by
    dsimp [tokens]
    omega
  have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_left q ht
  dsimp [resource] at hr
  have hxN := hx.2.1
  exact ⟨by omega, by omega, hi⟩

theorem scheduled_mem {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q a t : ℕ} {R : Finset ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {d : Descriptor} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hp : ValidPolicy A q N R choice) (ht : t ≤ N)
    (hd : Scheduled q choice a t d) : d ∈ schedule N q choice a t := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨b, u, _, hut, _, _, _, hbl, hpu, _⟩ := scheduled_origin hq hp ht hd
  have hpa : anchor d ≤ N := by omega
  have hla : nominal d ≤ N := by omega
  apply mem_filter.mpr
  refine ⟨?_, hd⟩
  rcases d with ⟨kind, p, l⟩
  simp only [anchor, nominal] at hpa hla
  simp [Universe, hpa, hla]

theorem parallel_completion {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q b u a l : ℕ} {R : Finset ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {d : Descriptor} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hp : ValidPolicy A q N R choice) (hu : u ≤ N)
    (hd : d ∈ remaining N q choice b u a) (hl : 0 < l) (hld : l ≤ nominal d) :
    (false, anchor d, l) ∈ remaining N q choice b u a := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hlist, ha⟩ := mem_filter.mp hd
  obtain ⟨b', u', _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hcomplete⟩ :=
    scheduled_origin hq hp hu (mem_filter.mp hlist).2
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨scheduled_mem hq hp hu (hcomplete l hl hld), ha⟩

theorem direct_descriptor_exists {N q f b u a v : ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hf : f ≤ 10 * q)
    (hw : a + 100 * q < v)
    (hd : v ≤ a + 2 * splitLength N q f choice b u a) :
    ∃ d ∈ remaining N q choice b u a,
      nominal d = longest N q choice b u a := by
  classical
  have hL : 0 < longest N q choice b u a := by
    by_contra h
    have hzero : longest N q choice b u a = 0 := by omega
    simp only [splitLength, hzero, zero_max] at hd
    omega
  have hn : (remaining N q choice b u a).Nonempty := by
    by_contra h
    have he := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h
    simp [longest, he] at hL
  obtain ⟨d, hd, heq⟩ := exists_mem_eq_sup (remaining N q choice b u a) hn nominal
  exact ⟨d, hd, heq.symm⟩

theorem scheduled_wellFounded {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q s f : ℕ} {R : Finset ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs : s ≤ q)
    (hf : f ≤ 10 * q) (hp : ValidPolicy A q N R choice) :
    WellFounded (fun y x => ∃ c low, Step A N q s f choice x y c low) := by
  apply (measure (fun x : State => x.finish - x.start)).wf.mono
  intro y x h
  obtain ⟨c, low, h⟩ := h
  exact (step_nested hq hs0 hs hf hp h).2.2.2.1

def ProfileLipschitz (A : ℕ → ℝ) (D : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ D ∧ ∀ i j, |A i - A j| ≤ D * |(i : ℝ) - (j : ℝ)|

theorem potential_near_point {A : ℕ → ℝ} {q a t p : ℕ} {V D : ℝ}
    (hLip : ProfileLipschitz A D) (hw : a + 10 * q ≤ t)
    (hap : a ≤ p) (hpt : p ≤ t) (hV : Potential A q a t V) :
    V ≤ 2 * A p + 20 * D * (q : ℝ) := by
  let i := max a (p - 10 * q)
  let j := i + 10 * q
  have hai : a ≤ i := le_max_left _ _
  have hip : i ≤ p := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have hpj : p ≤ j := by dsimp [i, j]; omega
  have hjt : j ≤ t := by dsimp [i, j]; omega
  have hdisti : p ≤ i + 10 * q := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have hdistj : j ≤ p + 10 * q := by dsimp [j]; omega
  have hpair := hV.2 i j ⟨hai, by dsimp [j]; omega, hjt⟩
  have hiReal : (i : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hip
  have hjReal : (p : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hpj
  have hdi : (p : ℝ) ≤ (i : ℝ) + 10 * (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdisti
  have hdj : (j : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) + 10 * (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdistj
  have hli := hLip.2 i p
  have hlj := hLip.2 j p
  rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hiReal)] at hli
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hjReal)] at hlj
  have hiVal := (le_abs_self (A i - A p)).trans hli
  have hjVal := (le_abs_self (A j - A p)).trans hlj
  have hD := hLip.1
  nlinarith

theorem run_profile_saving {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q s f : ℕ} {R : Finset ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {x z : State} {n m : ℕ} {C V D : ℝ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs : s ≤ q) (hf : f ≤ 10 * q)
    (hp : ValidPolicy A q N R choice) (hLip : ProfileLipschitz A D)
    (hx : Valid N s x) (hV : Potential A q x.start x.finish V)
    (h : Run A N q s f choice x z n m C) :
    2 * A x.start - 2 * A z.start + C ≤ 2 * A x.start - V + 20 * D * (q : ℝ) := by
  induction h generalizing V with
  | nil x =>
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, _⟩ := hV.1
    have hw : x.start + 10 * q ≤ x.finish := by
      dsimp [Admissible] at hij
      omega
    have ht := potential_near_point hLip hw (le_refl x.start) hx.1 hV
    linarith
  | @cons x y z c C low n m hstep htail ih =>
    have hn := step_nested hq hs0 hs hf hp hstep
    by_cases hw : y.start + 10 * q ≤ y.finish
    · obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ := potential_exists A q y.start y.finish hw
      have hpay := step_payment hq hs0 hs hf hp hstep hV hW
      have hrest := ih hn.2.2.2.2 hW
      linarith
    · have hzero := short_child_zero_cost hq hs hf hp hstep (by omega)
      obtain ⟨rfl, _, _, hC⟩ := terminal_run (by omega) htail
      have hwx : x.start + 10 * q ≤ x.finish := by
        have := hstep.nonterminal
        omega
      have ht := potential_near_point hLip hwx hn.1
        (hn.2.2.1.trans hn.2.1) hV
      linarith

theorem real_budgets {N q s K n m : ℕ} {κ σ : ℝ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hs : 0 < s) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκsmall : κ ≤ 1) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hqN : κ * (N : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ)) (hsN : σ * (N : ℝ) ≤ (s : ℝ))
    (hK : (K : ℝ) ≤ 1 / κ + 2)
    (hn : q * n ≤ q * (3 * K + 2) + N) (hm : s * m ≤ N) :
    (n : ℝ) ≤ 20 / κ ∧ (m : ℝ) ≤ 1 / σ := by
  have hqR : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hsR : (0 : ℝ) < s := by exact_mod_cast hs
  have hnR : (q : ℝ) * n ≤ q * (3 * (K : ℝ) + 2) + N := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hmR : (s : ℝ) * m ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hratio : (N : ℝ) / q ≤ 1 / κ := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hqR hκ).mpr
    nlinarith
  have hn' : (n : ℝ) ≤ 3 * (K : ℝ) + 2 + (N : ℝ) / q := by
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hqR).mp
    have heq := div_mul_cancel₀ (N : ℝ) (ne_of_gt hqR)
    nlinarith
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / κ := (le_div_iff₀ hκ).mpr (by linarith)
  have hnfinal : (n : ℝ) ≤ 20 / κ := by
    have h20 : 20 / κ = 20 * (1 / κ) := by ring
    rw [h20]
    nlinarith
  have hm' : (m : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) / s := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hsR).mpr
    nlinarith
  have hratio' : (N : ℝ) / s ≤ 1 / σ := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hsR hσ).mpr
    nlinarith
  exact ⟨hnfinal, hm'.trans hratio'⟩

noncomputable def smoothingBudget (κ σ : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  ⌈100 * (1 / κ + 1 / σ) + 100⌉₊

theorem smoothing_room {κ σ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    20 / κ + 1 / σ + 1 < (smoothingBudget κ σ : ℝ) := by
  have hc := Nat.le_ceil (100 * (1 / κ + 1 / σ) + 100)
  have hki : 0 < 1 / κ := one_div_pos.mpr hκ
  have hsi : 0 < 1 / σ := one_div_pos.mpr hσ
  dsimp [smoothingBudget]
  have h20 : 20 / κ = 20 * (1 / κ) := by ring
  rw [h20]
  nlinarith

theorem actual_anchor_bound {N q : ℕ} {r : ℕ → ℕ} {κ : ℝ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hqN : κ * (N : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ)) :
    ((Anchors N q r).card : ℝ) ≤ 1 / κ + 2 := by
  have hcard := anchors_card N q r
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left q hcard
  have hfloor := Nat.div_mul_le_self N q
  have hKN : q * (Anchors N q r).card ≤ N + q := by
    simp only [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one] at hmul
    nlinarith
  have hqR : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hKNR : (q : ℝ) * ((Anchors N q r).card : ℝ) ≤ N + q := by exact_mod_cast hKN
  have hratio : (N : ℝ) / q ≤ 1 / κ := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hqR hκ).mpr
    nlinarith
  have hK : ((Anchors N q r).card : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) / q + 1 := by
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hqR).mp
    have heq := div_mul_cancel₀ (N : ℝ) (ne_of_gt hqR)
    nlinarith
  linarith

theorem scheduled_recursion_core {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q s f : ℕ} {R : Finset ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {κ σ D : ℝ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs : s ≤ q) (hf : f ≤ 10 * q)
    (hp : ValidPolicy A q N R choice) (hLip : ProfileLipschitz A D)
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκsmall : κ ≤ 1) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hqN : κ * (N : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ)) (hsN : σ * (N : ℝ) ≤ (s : ℝ))
    (hK : (R.card : ℝ) ≤ 1 / κ + 2) :
    WellFounded (fun y x => ∃ c low, Step A N q s f choice x y c low) ∧
      ∀ (x z : State) (n m : ℕ) (C V : ℝ),
        Valid N s x → x.index = 0 → Potential A q x.start x.finish V →
        Run A N q s f choice x z n m C →
        (n : ℝ) ≤ 20 / κ ∧ (m : ℝ) ≤ 1 / σ ∧
        z.index + 1 < smoothingBudget κ σ ∧
        2 * A x.start - 2 * A z.start + C ≤
          2 * A x.start - V + 20 * D * (q : ℝ) := by
  refine ⟨scheduled_wellFounded hq hs0 hs hf hp, ?_⟩
  intro x z n m C V hx hi hV hrun
  obtain ⟨hn, hm, hindex⟩ := run_integer_budget hq hs0 hs hf hp hx hrun
  obtain ⟨hnR, hmR⟩ := real_budgets hq hs0 hκ hκsmall hσ hqN hsN hK hn hm
  have hroom := smoothing_room hκ hσ
  have hindex' : z.index ≤ n + m := by omega
  have hiR : (z.index : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hindex'
  have hroom' : (z.index : ℝ) + 1 < (smoothingBudget κ σ : ℝ) := by linarith
  exact ⟨hnR, hmR, by exact_mod_cast hroom',
    run_profile_saving hq hs0 hs hf hp hLip hx hV hrun⟩

theorem run_append {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q s f : ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {x y z : State} {n₁ m₁ n₂ m₂ : ℕ} {C₁ C₂ : ℝ}
    (h₁ : Run A N q s f choice x y n₁ m₁ C₁)
    (h₂ : Run A N q s f choice y z n₂ m₂ C₂) :
    Run A N q s f choice x z (n₁ + n₂) (m₁ + m₂) (C₁ + C₂) := by
  induction h₁ with
  | nil x => simpa using h₂
  | cons hstep htail ih =>
    have h := Run.cons hstep (ih h₂)
    simpa only [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm, add_assoc] using h

def Reachable (A : ℕ → ℝ) (N q s f : ℕ) (choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (root x : State) : Prop :=
  ∃ n m C, Run A N q s f choice root x n m C

theorem branch_extraction {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q s f : ℕ} {R : Finset ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {root : State} {value : State → ℝ}
    {B ε η : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs : s ≤ q) (hf : f ≤ 10 * q)
    (hp : ValidPolicy A q N R choice) (hroot : Valid N s root)
    (hlocal : ∀ x, Valid N s x → Reachable A N q s f choice root x →
      value x ≤ B ∨ ∃ y c low, Step A N q s f choice x y c low ∧
        value x ≤ 2 * A x.start - 2 * A y.start + c +
          (if low then η else ε) + value y) :
    ∃ z n m C, Run A N q s f choice root z n m C ∧
      value root ≤ 2 * A root.start - 2 * A z.start + C +
        (n : ℝ) * ε + (m : ℝ) * η + B := by
  have wf := scheduled_wellFounded hq hs0 hs hf hp
  have hex : ∀ x, Valid N s x → Reachable A N q s f choice root x →
      ∃ z n m C, Run A N q s f choice x z n m C ∧
        value x ≤ 2 * A x.start - 2 * A z.start + C +
          (n : ℝ) * ε + (m : ℝ) * η + B := by
    intro x
    induction x using wf.induction with
    | h x ih =>
      intro hx hreach
      rcases hlocal x hx hreach with hstop | ⟨y, c, low, hstep, hval⟩
      · exact ⟨x, 0, 0, 0, Run.nil x, by simpa using hstop⟩
      · obtain ⟨n₀, m₀, C₀, hprefix⟩ := hreach
        have hsingle := Run.cons hstep (Run.nil y)
        have hyreach : Reachable A N q s f choice root y :=
          ⟨_, _, _, run_append hprefix hsingle⟩
        have hyvalid := (step_nested hq hs0 hs hf hp hstep).2.2.2.2
        obtain ⟨z, n, m, C, hrun, hbound⟩ := ih y ⟨c, low, hstep⟩ hyvalid hyreach
        refine ⟨z, n + if low then 0 else 1, m + if low then 1 else 0,
          c + C, Run.cons hstep hrun, ?_⟩
        cases low <;>
          simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.true_eq, ite_false, ite_true,
            Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_zero, Nat.cast_one, Nat.add_zero] at * <;>
          nlinarith
  exact hex root hroot ⟨0, 0, 0, Run.nil root⟩

theorem maxplus_closure {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q s f : ℕ} {R : Finset ℕ}
    {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {root : State} {value : State → ℝ}
    {κ σ D V B ε η : ℝ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs : s ≤ q) (hf : f ≤ 10 * q)
    (hp : ValidPolicy A q N R choice) (hLip : ProfileLipschitz A D)
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκsmall : κ ≤ 1) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hqN : κ * (N : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ)) (hsN : σ * (N : ℝ) ≤ (s : ℝ))
    (hK : (R.card : ℝ) ≤ 1 / κ + 2)
    (hroot : Valid N s root) (hi : root.index = 0)
    (hV : Potential A q root.start root.finish V) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hlocal : ∀ x, Valid N s x → x.index < smoothingBudget κ σ →
      value x ≤ B ∨ ∃ y c low, Step A N q s f choice x y c low ∧
        value x ≤ 2 * A x.start - 2 * A y.start + c +
          (if low then η else ε) + value y) :
    value root ≤ 2 * A root.start - V + 20 * D * (q : ℝ) +
      B + (20 / κ) * ε + (1 / σ) * η := by
  have hcore := (scheduled_recursion_core hq hs0 hs hf hp hLip hκ hκsmall hσ hqN hsN hK).2
  have hlocal' : ∀ x, Valid N s x → Reachable A N q s f choice root x →
      value x ≤ B ∨ ∃ y c low, Step A N q s f choice x y c low ∧
        value x ≤ 2 * A x.start - 2 * A y.start + c +
          (if low then η else ε) + value y := by
    intro x hx hreach
    obtain ⟨n, m, C, hrun⟩ := hreach
    have hroom := (hcore root x n m C V hroot hi hV hrun).2.2.1
    exact hlocal x hx (by omega)
  obtain ⟨z, n, m, C, hrun, hbound⟩ := branch_extraction hq hs0 hs hf hp hroot hlocal'
  obtain ⟨hn, hm, _, hsave⟩ := hcore root z n m C V hroot hi hV hrun
  have hnε := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hn hε
  have hmη := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm hη
  linarith

def BlockSelection (A : ℕ → ℝ) (N q : ℕ) (r : ℕ → ℕ)
    (choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ a t, a + 100 * q < t → t ≤ N →
    ∃ b, Eligible q a t b ∧ choice a t = r b ∧
      ∀ c, Eligible q a t c → A (r b) ≤ A (r c)

theorem fixed_selection_valid {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N q : ℕ}
    {r : ℕ → ℕ} {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hr : Representatives A q r) (hc : BlockSelection A N q r choice) :
    ValidPolicy A q N (Anchors N q r) choice := by
  intro a t hw ht
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hchoice, hmin⟩ := hc a t hw ht
  have hpol := selected_policy hq hr hb hmin
  have hbN : b ≤ N / q := by
    apply (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hq).mpr
    have hb₁ := (hr b).1
    have hpN := hpol.right
    omega
  rw [hchoice]
  exact ⟨hpol, mem_image.mpr ⟨b, by simp [hbN], rfl⟩⟩

theorem ceiling_parameters {N : ℕ} {κ σ : ℝ} (hN : 0 < N)
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hσκ : σ ≤ κ) :
    0 < ⌈κ * (N : ℝ)⌉₊ ∧ 0 < ⌈σ * (N : ℝ)⌉₊ ∧
    ⌈σ * (N : ℝ)⌉₊ ≤ ⌈κ * (N : ℝ)⌉₊ ∧
    ⌈10 * σ * (N : ℝ)⌉₊ ≤ 10 * ⌈κ * (N : ℝ)⌉₊ ∧
    κ * (N : ℝ) ≤ (⌈κ * (N : ℝ)⌉₊ : ℝ) ∧
    σ * (N : ℝ) ≤ (⌈σ * (N : ℝ)⌉₊ : ℝ) := by
  have hNR : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hq := Nat.le_ceil (κ * (N : ℝ))
  have hs := Nat.le_ceil (σ * (N : ℝ))
  have hcomp : σ * (N : ℝ) ≤ κ * (N : ℝ) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hσκ (le_of_lt hNR)
  refine ⟨Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (mul_pos hκ hNR), Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (mul_pos hσ hNR),
    Nat.ceil_le.mpr (hcomp.trans hq), ?_, hq, hs⟩
  apply Nat.ceil_le.mpr
  push_cast
  nlinarith

theorem manuscript_closure {A : ℕ → ℝ} {N : ℕ} {κ σ D V B ε η : ℝ}
    {r : ℕ → ℕ} {choice : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {root : State} {value : State → ℝ}
    (hN : 0 < N) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκsmall : κ ≤ 1) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hσκ : σ ≤ κ)
    (hr : Representatives A ⌈κ * (N : ℝ)⌉₊ r)
    (hc : BlockSelection A N ⌈κ * (N : ℝ)⌉₊ r choice)
    (hLip : ProfileLipschitz A D)
    (hroot : Valid N ⌈σ * (N : ℝ)⌉₊ root) (hi : root.index = 0)
    (hV : Potential A ⌈κ * (N : ℝ)⌉₊ root.start root.finish V)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hlocal : ∀ x, Valid N ⌈σ * (N : ℝ)⌉₊ x → x.index < smoothingBudget κ σ →
      value x ≤ B ∨ ∃ y c low,
        Step A N ⌈κ * (N : ℝ)⌉₊ ⌈σ * (N : ℝ)⌉₊
          ⌈10 * σ * (N : ℝ)⌉₊ choice x y c low ∧
        value x ≤ 2 * A x.start - 2 * A y.start + c +
          (if low then η else ε) + value y) :
    value root ≤ 2 * A root.start - V +
      20 * D * (⌈κ * (N : ℝ)⌉₊ : ℝ) + B + (20 / κ) * ε + (1 / σ) * η := by
  obtain ⟨hq, hs0, hs, hf, hqN, hsN⟩ := ceiling_parameters hN hκ hσ hσκ
  have hp := fixed_selection_valid hq hr hc
  have hK := actual_anchor_bound (r := r) hq hκ hqN
  exact maxplus_closure hq hs0 hs hf hp hLip hκ hκsmall hσ hqN hsN hK
    hroot hi hV hε hη hlocal
